status: COMPLETE actual full-source periodic L2/continuous/L-infinity projection constructions, full complex algebraic-range and rank transport, H1 domain preservation, physical Green symmetry and exact source half-integral normalization. High source-circle validity/rank two, periodic convergence and quantitative 2.13/C.4 remain OPEN.
results: For EVERY original COMPLEX H-minus-one potential, the ACTUAL periodic Riesz range equals the sum of ALL enclosed original algebraic root spaces, including associated vectors. Reality, endpoint bounds and semisimplicity are not assumed. The same projection fixes enclosed root vectors and kills the full root spaces outside its closed disk.

The ACTUAL full-base periodic contour lifts into the ENTIRE original periodic H1 domain, preserves the original partial-operator domain and intertwines the actual unbounded expression. Its H1 restriction is a genuine idempotent. Energy analyticity and complex bilinear Green symmetry are proved for the ACTUAL full H1 resolvent and contour lift.

ALL source-normalized period-two physical L2 data have a faithful inclusion in the FULL original H-minus-one base; ALL original H1 vectors have a faithful physical L2 realization. Every original raw coefficient is retained, and the physical-domain inclusion composes to EXACTLY the native original domain inclusion. No physical period-one or smaller operator-domain condition is imposed on L2 inputs.

The ACTUAL periodic projection is CONSTRUCTED on the ENTIRE source physical L2 space, from the SAME original contour lift. It intertwines the actual base/domain projections, is idempotent on valid circles, and has finite-dimensional range LINEARLY EQUIVALENT to the ENTIRE original native algebraic range. Algebraic rank and ALL complex associated vectors are preserved.

Continuous representatives and genuine essential-supremum outputs of the SAME ACTUAL periodic projection are CONSTRUCTED. Their L2 classes are exactly the original projection outputs; L-infinity and L2 outputs are the SAME functions almost everywhere. Continuous-to-Lp inclusions for EVERY 1<=p<=infinity have norm at most ONE under source probability normalization. Both L2 and L-infinity projection-difference norms are bounded by the continuous-output operator difference with constant ONE.

The physical periodic L2 norm squared is EXACTLY ONE HALF the integral of the norm squared over [0,2]. The full original dual evaluation on ALL physical L2 inputs and original H1 tests is EXACTLY ONE HALF the unconjugated physical product integral over [0,2], with Cauchy-Schwarz constant ONE. The same identity holds for original domain masses.

The ACTUAL periodic L2 projection preserves the literal physical complex BILINEAR integral pairing. The result holds for ALL original complex H-minus-one potentials and ALL physical L2 inputs on every valid circle. No Hermitian self-adjointness assertion for complex potentials is used.

The article periodic P_(n,q), continuous-output and L-infinity-output operators are defined on the LITERAL original source circle |z-(pi*n)^2|=n, from the ENTIRE original complex physically period-one H-minus-one distribution. On valid source circles the same actual idempotence, finite rank, algebraic-root-space correspondence, physical Green symmetry and a.e. agreement are proved. Source-circle validity and high-energy rank TWO are NOT supplied by these construction theorems.
essential_remaining: Prove common high-energy periodic SOURCE-circle validity and algebraic rank TWO; construct the actual source orthonormal two-vector basis and prove the quantitative off-diagonal eta estimate in Lemma 2.13.

Prove periodic P_(n,q)-P_(n,0) -> 0 in actual source L2-to-L-infinity norm, with the source locally uniform endpoint quantifiers. The projection/norm constructions in this milestone do NOT prove convergence.

Prove the precise Appendix C.4 fractional-Sobolev logarithmic rate, and finish the full eta/gamma residual (31), source overlap (32), Lemma 2.15 and the full COMPLEX weighted midpoint Theorem 2.1(ii). The previous actual Dirichlet o(1) result remains proved.
Complete the remaining original Birkhoff-map and actual KdV approximation-flow constructions needed for the five MAIN theorems 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 5.1 and 5.9. All five remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE.

source_correspondence.potential: ENTIRE original COMPLEX periodic H-minus-one distribution. Native results allow all such potentials; article adapters retain physical period one and arbitrary mean, including the source mean-zero complex class.
source_correspondence.operator_domain: ENTIRE original periodic H1 domain in FourierLebesgueSpace(2,1,2), with its actual partial operator in the full FourierLebesgueSpace(2,-1,2) base.
source_correspondence.physical_input: ENTIRE period-two CircleL2 Hilbert space, probability Haar measure with EXACT norm-square (1/2)*integral_0^2 |F|^2. Physical input functions are not required to have period one.
source_correspondence.projection: ACTUAL source-oriented native contour lifted in the full H1 operator norm, faithfully realized in physical L2, C(AddCircle 2,C) and actual L-infinity. Article circles are literally center (pi*n)^2 and radius n.
source_correspondence.range: ALL enclosed original complex algebraic root spaces; full associated vectors retained. Physical and native ranges are linearly equivalent and have equal rank. Rank two itself is not yet proved uniformly at the literal high source circles.
source_correspondence.pairing: Original dual evaluation and domain masses are EXACTLY (1/2)*integral_0^2 F*g, unconjugated. The actual physical projection preserves the bilinear Green integral. No Hermitian self-adjointness premise is used for complex q.
source_correspondence.hypotheses: Idempotence, root-space range, finite rank and Green symmetry require the displayed actual resolvent-circle condition; they are NOT unconditional high-n validity/convergence statements.
source_correspondence.norm_comparisons: Both actual L2 and L-infinity operator differences are bounded by the actual continuous-output difference with constant ONE. The high-energy convergence estimate needed by (33) remains to be proved.
